_comment: Deep-merged over the upstream vscode product.json by scripts/prepare.mjs.
A null value deletes the upstream key.
Telemetry needs no entry here: the OSS build has no aiConfig.ariaKey and
telemetryUtils.ts gates every appender on it, so nothing is ever sent.
Likewise updateUrl / nlsCoreBaseUrl / experimentsUrl / tasConfig are absent
upstream and must simply not be reintroduced.
_comment_webview: MUST be removed: left in place, environmentService.ts resolves webviews to
vscode-cdn.net and every webview breaks offline. staticify.mjs supplies a
_comment_copilot: defaultChatAgent is deliberately LEFT INTACT. Removing it breaks startup:
assertDefined(product.defaultChatAgent, ...) at module scope, and ~38 other
sites read fields off it. The workbench refuses to construct without it.
Copilot is instead disabled the way the user asked for: the extension is
not bundled, so none of these endpoints are ever contacted, and the URLs
remain inert config. staticify.mjs defaults chat.disableAIFeatures to true
so the chat status bar entry does not advertise a product this build has no
way to install: Open VSX carries neither GitHub.copilot nor
GitHub.copilot-chat. Both halves are reversible by configuration.
See endpoint-allowlist.json for the per-endpoint justification.
_comment_gallery: Open VSX, as VSCodium does. No Microsoft endpoints.
